source: S. Rep. No. 112-173, at 23-24 (2012), as quoted at GAO-15-548 printed p. 1 fn 2
text: Senate Report 112-173 directed the Secretary of the Army to report on the Army's analysis and plans to utilise and configure its government-owned/contractor-operated facility, where Abrams tanks are produced, to meet the Army's tank and other tracked and wheeled vehicle production requirements to 2025 and beyond.
